class.name: VideoPresetSettingsServer
class.brief_description: Settings server for graphics presets (Low, Medium, High, Ultra, Custom) over the four video settings domains.

method.name: add_preset
method.description: Adds [param preset] after the other presets, or replaces the preset with the same [member VideoPreset.preset_name]. The name can't be empty or [code]"Custom"[/code]. The change lasts until [method reload_presets] or the end of the game.

method.name: apply_preset
method.description: Sets all values of the domain resources of the preset [param name] in the video domains ([code]null[/code] resources are skipped), one step per domain (see the class description), skipping values a domain doesn't support, and stores [param name] as the chosen preset. Returns [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] if there is no such preset, [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] for [code]"Custom"[/code], or the first error of [method SettingsServer.apply]. Values a domain doesn't have are skipped with a warning.

method.name: create_builtin_preset
method.description: Returns a new [VideoPreset] with the values of the built-in preset [param name] ([code]"Low"[/code], [code]"Medium"[/code], [code]"High"[/code] or [code]"Ultra"[/code]), or [code]null[/code] for another name. It has a settings resource for all four domains: a copy of the domain's defaults ([method SettingsServer.get_default_settings], from the project settings) with the quality values of the preset, so values like brightness or the default texture filter keep the project's choice. A starting point for project presets: change it and save it as a [code].tres[/code] file. The built-in presets set: resolution scale, mesh LOD threshold, 3D MSAA, screen-space anti-aliasing, TAA and debanding ([RenderQualitySettings]); anisotropic filtering, 2D SDF scale and 2D shadow atlas size ([TextureSettings]); directional and positional shadow atlas size and soft shadow filter quality ([VideoShadowSettings]); SSAO, SSIL, SDFGI, VoxelGI, volumetric fog, subsurface scattering and depth of field quality, and on Low the switches for SSAO, SSIL, SSR and volumetric fog ([VideoEffectSettings]). "High" is close to the engine defaults.

method.name: detect_preset
method.description: Returns the name of the first preset whose values match the pending values of the video domains, or [code]"Custom"[/code]. Unlike [method get_current_preset], the stored choice doesn't matter.

method.name: get_builtin_preset_names
method.description: Returns the names of the built-in presets from the lowest to the highest: [code]["Low", "Medium", "High", "Ultra"][/code].

method.name: get_current_preset
method.description: Returns the name of the current preset: the one applied last, [code]"Custom"[/code] after a single change, or (if none was picked yet or the stored preset no longer exists) the result of [method detect_preset].

method.name: get_custom_preset_name
method.description: Returns [code]"Custom"[/code], the name of the current preset after a single change. No preset can have this name.

method.name: get_preset
method.description: Returns the preset [param name], or [code]null[/code]. The preset is the one in the list: changes to it take effect on the next [method apply_preset].

method.name: get_preset_names
method.description: Returns the names of all presets in their order: the built-in presets first, then the presets added by the project.

method.name: get_presets
method.description: Returns all presets in the order of [method get_preset_names].

method.name: has_preset
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if there is a preset [param name].

method.name: matches_preset
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the pending values of the video domains have every supported value of the domain resources of the preset [param name].

method.name: reload_presets
method.description: Builds the list of presets again from the built-in presets and [member ProjectSettings.settings/video_preset/presets]. Presets added with [method add_preset] are dropped.

method.name: remove_preset
method.description: Removes the preset [param name] from the list until [method reload_presets] or the end of the game. If it was the current preset, [method get_current_preset] detects the preset from the values.

method.name: suggest_preset
method.description: Returns a preset for the current hardware: [code]"Low"[/code] for the Compatibility renderer or a CPU adapter, [code]"Medium"[/code] for the Mobile renderer or an integrated GPU, [code]"High"[/code] for a discrete GPU ([method RenderingServer.get_video_adapter_type]). [code]"Ultra"[/code] is never suggested. If the preset doesn't exist, the next lower built-in name that exists; an empty [String] if none does.

signal.name: preset_changed
signal.description: Emitted when [method get_current_preset] changes: after [method apply_preset], after a change in a video domain that gives [code]"Custom"[/code] or another preset, and when the stored name is loaded, reset or changed.
